rows.grounds: Instrumental plural compound gandha-puṣpa-ādi followed by gerund yaṣṭvā (root yaj); sandhi fusion bhis+yaṣṭvā written as one token.
Object of the ritual action completed by kṛtvā.
Absolutive expressing a prior action in the ritual sequence.
Instrumental plural compound jaya-ādi indicating accompanying formulas or rites.

items.question: Which offerings and fire rites complete the worship sequence after adorning the artisan?
premises: Worship is performed using fragrances, flowers, and similar offerings.
A fire oblation is performed as part of the sequence.
The fire oblation is accompanied by victory and related formulas.
items.inference: The ritual sequence is completed by worship with offerings followed by a fire oblation accompanied by jayādi formulas.
uncertainties: The specific items included in gandhapuṣpādi and the exact formulas denoted by jayādi are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having worshipped with fragrances, flowers, and the like, and having performed the fire oblation with the victory formulas and so on.
